title: Components of providers docs update
body:
Documentation for the standard provider package was incomplete and in some cases incorrect:
  - Added "and Sensors" to Step 4 description alongside examples
  - Fixed incorrect reference to EmailOperator (actually in smtp provider, not standard)
  - Removed misleading claim that operators are "in the apache-airflow package"

 Step 4: Install the Standard Provider

+- Some of the commonly used Operators, Sensors, and Triggers which were bundled as part of the ``airflow-core`` package (for example ``BashOperator``, ``PythonOperator``, ``ExternalTaskSensor``, ``FileSensor``, etc.)
